assign.request: Design ext/Playground — a simpler Panel, fresh eyes (no Panel source read). Documents (figma-like, one tree each) on Item/List, tree|workspace|properties shell with grips, item types for flex/grid, toolbar, reusable layouts as JSON. Deliver design.md (<=150 lines) + build order. Design only, no build.
steps: Read the base (CLAUDE.md, Item/List, Saver, grip, drawer, Sidebar, layout/words, styles, ui)
layout skill — the shell's three sizing questions
Item types: brainstorm, the MVP three, data schemas

log.msg: Directory.js ignores files ending .json in the chokidar watcher (line 21-24), so a newly saved document never rebuilds public/directory.json — document enumeration cannot use it. The index is its own Item document (/data/playground/index.json), which also works on a static host.

ext/grip measures `edge = parent.getBoundingClientRect().right; px = edge - clientX` — correct for a right-docked rail only. The LEFT (tree) divider needs a mirrored read; ask grip for a 3-line `from: "start"` option rather than a second grip.
Item.hydrate keeps ids (its `seen` set dedups within one call only), so paste-into-the-same-document would mint duplicate ids — paste must strip id recursively before hydrate.
ext/editor readme names the trap this design inherits: only add/remove may repaint; a `change` repaint replaces the element the properties panel holds. Selection is an id, never a node.

assign.outcome: **ext/Playground designed, fresh — one idea: an `Item` tree rendered as the real thing.** Its `data` IS the CSS (values verbatim, as strings), its wire JSON IS the copy-paste format, one saved subtree IS a reusable layout — nothing translates, so nothing drifts. [design.md](/framework/ai/2026-08-19/playground-design/design.md) — 150 lines: an ASCII shell sketch (tree | canvas | properties, two grips, three deliberate scrollports), documents as `/data/playground/<slug>.json` with the index as its own document, the MVP three (`Flex` `Grid` `Box`) with full data schemas + one example document, workspace/properties/toolbar, reusable layouts, the learning UX, a 9-file map, and a 5-task build order for Sonnet with headless proofs. Three findings that shape it: the dev server`s Directory watcher ignores `.json` files (`Server/plugins/Directory.js:21`) so `directory.json` can never list documents; `ext/grip` measures `parent.right - clientX`, right for the properties rail only — the tree divider needs a 3-line `from: "start"` option; `Item.hydrate` keeps ids, so paste must strip them recursively. Left: no code (design-only brief), and `../panel-insight/insight.md` did not exist at landing (sibling at step 2/8), so the §Borrowed/Avoided section says so — a follow-up can add ten lines.
